object.attr: stakeholder: an enumeration has no order, so lt and the like have no meaning on one. A misfit loads (MELLON-STORE-SRS-149) and is reported when applied (MELLON-EDIT-SRS-306) (review Q14).
object.description: When Mellon applies a filter, Mellon shall accept on an enumeration attribute only the operators eq, ne, is-empty and is-not-empty.
